pool.text: The Saadian Sultan Abdallah al-Ghalib constructed the famous Ben Youssef Madrasa.
The construction ordered by Abdallah al-Ghalib was successfully completed.
Mamounia Hotel was built by Henri Prost and A in Marrakesh.
A protocol giving independence to Morocco was signed by Christian Pineau and M’Barek Ben Bakkai.
The historic building was refurbished and reopened to the public as a historical site.
UNESCO declared the old town area of Marrakesh a World Heritage Site.
The Marrakesh Agreement was signed to establish the World Trade Organisation.
A palace was carefully restored and converted into a museum in Marrakesh.
The International Film Festival of Marrakech was established in Marrakesh.
The Moroccan government signed a loan agreement worth eight million U.S.
Vanessa Branson established the cultural festival known as the Marrakech Bienniale.
King Mohammed VI inaugurated the important road stretching from Marrakesh to Settat.
The House of Photography of Marrakech opened in the city.
Fatima-Zahra Mansouri was elected the first female mayor of Marrakesh.
King Mohammed VI inaugurated a regional psychiatric hospital built in Marrakesh.
A major gas explosion occurred within the city of Marrakesh.
A bomb attack took place in the Jemaa el-Fnaa square in Marrakesh.
A former home and villa was converted into the Berber Museum in Marrakesh.
The PDJ under Ahmed El Moutassadik won partial legislative elections in Marrakesh.
Artist André Heller opened the ANIMA garden between Marrakesh and the Atlas Mountains.
